tools.name: create_guest_token
tools.description: Create a short-lived MiniURL guest bearer token. Legacy MCP sessions retain it; stateless clients must pass the returned gt_ token explicitly on later requests. shorten_url can provision one automatically.

tools.name: clear_authentication
tools.description: Clear authentication retained by a legacy MCP session. Stateless clients clear authentication by omitting the Authorization header on later requests.

tools.name: shorten_url
tools.description: Create a MiniURL short link for a supplied HTTP or HTTPS destination. Use when the user asks to shorten a URL or generate a MiniURL link. This is an additive external write; do not fetch or open the destination. If no authentication is supplied, MiniURL automatically starts a guest flow. Reuse idemp

tools.name: send_registration_code
tools.description: Send a 6-digit registration code to the user email, using the current guest session.

tools.name: verify_registration_code
tools.description: Verify the emailed code, create the account, claim guest links, and continue with OAuth 2.1 + PKCE. Long-lived API keys are never returned over MCP.

tools.name: get_account_status
tools.description: Inspect the current guest/free/pro account status, remaining quota, and feature availability.

tools.name: start_pro_upgrade
tools.description: Create a shortened checkout link for upgrading the current registered account to Pro.

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: List domains available to the current registered account, including miniurl.com and active custom domains.

tools.name: add_domain
tools.description: Request a custom domain to be connected to MiniURL. Agent domain changes require human approval by default.

tools.name: delete_domain
tools.description: Delete a custom domain and its linked URLs after a dry-run confirmation. Agent domain changes require human approval by default.

tools.name: verify_domain
tools.description: Refresh custom-domain DNS and SSL verification status. Agent domain changes require human approval by default.

tools.name: list_links
tools.description: List short links for the current registered account.

tools.name: get_link
tools.description: Get a single short link by alias for the current registered account.

tools.name: update_link
tools.description: Update a registered short link. Some fields require Pro.

tools.name: delete_link
tools.description: Delete a registered short link permanently.

tools.name: bulk_create_links
tools.description: Create multiple short links in one request. Free accounts can create up to 10 at a time, Pro up to 50.

tools.name: get_link_stats
tools.description: Get link analytics. Free accounts receive a basic total plus an upgrade hint; Pro accounts receive full breakdowns.

tools.name: check_alias
tools.description: Check whether a custom alias is available on a given domain before creating a link.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List all tags for the current registered account. Tags help organise links into campaigns or categories.

tools.name: create_tag
tools.description: Create a new tag for organising links. Maximum 20 tags per account.

tools.name: delete_tag
tools.description: Delete a tag and remove it from all associated links.

tools.name: tag_link
tools.description: Add a tag to a short link for campaign or category organisation.

tools.name: untag_link
tools.description: Remove a tag from a short link.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: shorten_url · Private data: create_guest_token, verify_registration_code · Public sink: send_registration_code · Destructive: delete_domain, delete_link, delete_tag, untag_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: shorten_url · Private data: create_guest_token, verify_registration_code · Public sink: send_registration_code · Destructive: delete_domain, delete_link, delete_tag, untag_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "create_guest_token" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Create a MiniURL guest token and store it in an unauthenticated MCP session. If auth is already set, keep it or call clear_authentication first. shorten_url can provision a guest automatically." → after: "Create a short-lived MiniURL guest bearer token. Legacy MCP sessions retain it; stateless clients must pass the returned gt_ token explicitly on later requests. shorten_url can provision one automatically."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
